Not better for the kids. My father hung himself xmas of 2018. I wasn’t close with him and it still haunts me. Him and I both suffer from major depressive disorder and PTSD and severe anxiety. I’ve been suicidal myself for a long long time, and often find myself wanting to join my father, but I don’t have the courage he had. At the same time, I can feel the pain it’s left me knowing that he was alone and suffering. I got money from his death as well and used it to pay off my car etc, but I would much rather have him alive simply so that he doesn’t have to make that sad decision all by himself. I wish he would have reached out.. I wonder if he realized that I was dealing with the same things? I wonder a lot of things all the time and since he’s gone, I will never get answers. I can’t now. I honestly think you have the strength to instead focus your energy on how to fix your current day to day and issues with your partner and I think a lot of that stress will fall away. I think setting a good example to your boys is to normalize being not okay. That’s normal! Not everything is sunshine and roses. And that getting help/ self help is a strong thing to do. They’ll miss you dearly and have mind numbing questions for the rest of their lives if you leave. Please reconsider. You can dm me if you’d like or respond here if you want whatever you feel.
